# scenario other_user_join_part_and_quit: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco +bob / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),bob(+),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 5 S: :dave!dave@test JOIN #eco
	members #eco "alice(@),bob(+),dave,eco"
	status #eco "dave joined"

stream 6 S: :bob!bob@test PART #eco :later
	members #eco "alice(@),dave,eco"
	status #eco "bob left"

stream 7 S: :alice!alice@test QUIT :Ping timeout
	members #eco "dave,eco"
	status #eco "alice quit"

state #eco topic="topic" modes="" key="" members=[dave eco]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	status #eco "dave joined"
	status #eco "bob left"
	status #eco "alice quit"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
